sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Punisher - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Oh yeah, your last Scav massacre was something else! People keep coming up to me asking what the hell's going on. Turns out my buddies struck a deal with the locals and are putting together some kind of staged fights. Gladiator-style, you could say. Anyway, you're basically their... what's the word... test guy. They come up with ideas, watch how you handle them, then tweak things based on what they see. And now they want to keep it going. This time the jobs are a bit tougher. Hunt down Scavs wearing chest rigs and take them out with an SVD or a TKPD. Bring me their knives as trophies, too. So, what do you say, soldier?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 10 Scavs while using an SVDS or TKPD on Lighthouse
- Eliminate 10 Scavs while wearing a Scav Vest on Lighthouse
- Find 5 Bars A-2607 95Kh18 knives in raid
- Hand over the items

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 3× 7.62x54mm R PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
- 3× 9x39mm SP-6 gs ammo pack (20 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase of 7.62x54mm R PS gzh at Prapor LL4
- Unlocks purchase of 9x39mm SP-6 gs at Prapor LL4
"Mighty wicked, warrior. Grab your reward. Come back later, my friends have got some more work for you."

Either the Scav Vest or the Security vest can be used for the Scav kills.

The Bars A-2607 95Kh18 knives are carried by Scavs. Make sure to not confuse them with the similar looking Bars A-2607 Damascus knives.
